title: Indemnity Form
sources: Form B: Digital Indemnity & Scholar Code of Conduct

sections.heading: Participation and Booking Details
sections.body: This form applies to the Job Shadow experience identified in the booking details below. The scholar or tertiary student consents to taking part. Where the participant is a minor under applicable law, their parent or legal guardian must also consent and sign this form from their own linked account. The parent or legal guardian confirms that they are authorised to act for the participant.

sections.heading: Educational Nature of the Experience
sections.body: Job Shadow (Pty) Ltd provides educational career exploration. It is not acting as an employment, recruitment or employment placement agency. Participation is unpaid and does not constitute an offer of employment, an internship or a learnership. The participant will observe a professional workplace under the supervision of a mentor. Reasonable precautions will be taken for their safety, but an active workplace involves ordinary, inherent risks, including risks associated with travel to and from the location.

sections.heading: Code of Conduct and Confidentiality
sections.body: The participant agrees to arrive punctually at the confirmed location, follow the mentor's or company's dress code, and comply with reasonable instructions from assigned mentors and company personnel. The participant must follow all site security, safety and emergency procedures. They must respect confidential information, client privacy and intellectual property, and must not take photographs or make video or audio recordings without permission.

sections.heading: Health and Emergency Information
sections.body: The participant and, where required, their parent or legal guardian confirm that the personal, medical, emergency and contact information supplied to Job Shadow (Pty) Ltd is accurate. Any medical condition that could affect participation must be disclosed before the experience. If a medical emergency occurs and the parent or legal guardian cannot be contacted promptly, the mentor or company is authorised to arrange necessary emergency medical treatment for the participant. The parent or legal guardian accepts responsibility for the associated costs where they are signing for a minor.

sections.heading: Acknowledgement of Risk and Indemnity
sections.body: The participant and, where required, their parent or legal guardian acknowledge the ordinary, inherent risks of attending a workplace and travelling to and from it. To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, they release, indemnify and hold harmless Job Shadow (Pty) Ltd, its directors, employees and representatives, the individual mentor, and the host company and its employees and representatives against claims, loss, injury, illness or damage arising from participation or related travel. This does not exclude liability for gross negligence, wilful misconduct or a breach of statutory duties, and does not limit rights that applicable law does not permit to be excluded. The parent or legal guardian gives this acknowledgement in their own capacity and on behalf of the minor, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

sections.heading: Photography and Video
sections.body: Photography or video for Job Shadow's records and photography or video for promotional use require the separate permissions selected below. Permission for promotional use is optional and is not a condition of booking or participation. Where the participant is a minor, the linked parent or legal guardian must make the applicable permission choices. Permission for Job Shadow records: Allow / Do not allow. Permission for promotional use: Allow / Do not allow. No permission is assumed when a choice has not been made.

sections.heading: Declarations and Digital Signatures
sections.body: The participant confirms that they have read and understood this form, that their information is accurate, and that they agree to the participation terms and code of conduct. The parent or legal guardian, where required, confirms that they have read and understood the form, consent to the participant's attendance and the emergency medical arrangements, and agree to the applicable acknowledgements and indemnity. Each required signer must sign from their own account. The platform records each signature separately with the authenticated signer's user ID, the exact form version, date and time, and available IP address. Signing one area does not sign for the other person.

review_notes: Draft for client approval only. Forms B and C remain unchanged and active behavior is not replaced.
Consolidates Form B and the separate Standard JobShadow Indemnity Clauses. The Mentor and Company Safeguarding Undertaking is not merged into this participant form.
Proposed change for approval: replace the older promotional-photo opt-out clause with separate explicit choices for records and promotional use. This is not yet an active change.
Uses scholars and tertiary students, applicable-law wording and Job Shadow experiences rather than sessions. Parent or guardian signing remains mandatory where legally required for a minor.
Form A remains the separate personal-information and identity-verification consent. Form D is not a substitute for KYC consent.
